item.title: Re: Collapsible and ACS bar not working in sanbox?
item.content:encoded:
The ACS module needs a closing brace after its list of parameters. You need to add a "]]" after the last parameter.

The collapsible needs a closing tag after the stuff that you want to be inside the collapsible - "[[/collapsible]]". You have the opening tag ("[[collapsible]]"), but wikidot doesn't know where you want it to end.

item.title: Collapsible and ACS bar not working in sanbox?
item.content:encoded:
Here's the sandbox: http://scp-sandbox-3.wikidot.com/blazerboy69420-1

I moved the bhl code up top and left the ACS stuff alone but now the collapsible isn't working and neither is the ACS bar. please help me I'm starting to go mad because of this
